messages.name: savewindow
messages.description: The word, followed by a non-zero number, means that any unusual window settings caused bymessages towill be saved as part of the patch the next time the patch is saved. The messagemeans that changes to the window caused bymessages towill not be retained when the patch is saved; the prior patcher window settings are saved. If nomessage has been received, the patcher will be saved with a normal window appearance.

messages.name: setactivetab
messages.digest: Set the active tab in a tabbed patcher
messages.description: In a tabbed patcher, the active tab may be changed by passing themessage followed by the name of the subpatcher as displayed on the tab itself.
